user_query: I am writing an article on the Chilean government and need information on the Ministry of Education. Can you provide me with the name and position of the minister, their photo, and whether they are currently serving as a substitute? Additionally, give me a list of all ministries and subsecretaries.

TaskList.description: 查询教育部部长的姓名、职位、照片及是否为代理
获取所有部门及副部长的名单
